source_note: GitHub is authoritative for current code, releases, licensing and security guidance.

repositories.name: oyyo-one-ai
repositories.summary: The main public documentation hub for OYYO ONE AI, a private AI workspace and execution platform developed in Dubai.
details: Connects goals, context, model selection, specialist work, tools and usable outcomes.
Documents privacy boundaries, memory, agents, teams, business workflows, hardware and the wider OYYO repository map.
Current catalog snapshot documents 536 roles, 24 departments, 7 workflow groups, 50 specialist team presets, 1,361 tasks, 204 creative styles and 15 local text model candidates.
repositories.license: Public documentation. The private runtime and product implementation remain proprietary.

repositories.name: oyyo-trade-signals
repositories.summary: A public customer information center for an evidence rich market intelligence and decision support workspace.
details: Covers crypto, gold, forex and indices with research, alerts, paper trading, journaling and risk intelligence.
The documented signal contract records timestamp, horizon, instrument, market state, uncertainty, supporting and opposing evidence, sources, freshness, model version, provenance and limitations.
It is not a broker, does not place trades and does not provide personal investment advice.
repositories.license: Public product documentation. Proprietary application source and private runtime are not included.

repositories.name: url-intelligence-agent
repositories.summary: Evidence first web intelligence that turns a public URL into structured identity, provenance and discovery data.
details: TypeScript first, Node 18.17 or later, MCP native and usable through an HTTP API.
Version 1.5.0 adds reason codes, severity scoring, page classification, search posture, security quality, domain intelligence and machine readable provenance.
Includes reproducible benchmark material and report output in JSON, Markdown, HTML and PDF.
repositories.license: MIT

repositories.name: AI Best Model Route
repositories.summary: An open source LLM router and OpenAI compatible gateway that selects an eligible model for each request.
details: Routes by capability, quality, cost, latency, reliability, privacy, context size and runtime health.
Provides virtual routes such as auto, auto quality, auto fast, auto cheap, auto code and auto private.
Designed for multi provider applications, coding agents, local models, NVIDIA NIM, Codex and self hosted AI infrastructure.
repositories.license: Apache 2.0

repositories.name: LinkedIn SuperAgent MultiSkills
repositories.summary: A portable LinkedIn AI operating system for strategy, writing, profile work, analytics, recruiting and account workflows.
details: Version 2.2.0 includes 24 skills and manual, automatic and API operating modes.
The portable Markdown agent can be used in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and local AI workspaces.
Manual mode is the default. Consequential account actions remain subject to user approval and platform rules.
repositories.license: MIT

repositories.name: OYYO NotzUp
repositories.summary: The official download, release and documentation repository for a local first capture and knowledge workspace.
details: Brings meetings, recordings, screenshots, documents, images, video, text and links into a searchable source library.
Supports local transcription, OCR, summaries, action items, grounded visual descriptions, audio analysis and export workflows when the device and installed packs support them.
Public channels include Microsoft Store, Apple App Store, Snap Store, signed Android APK and Linux packages.
repositories.license: The application is proprietary. The repository publishes downloads, release notes and user guides.

repositories.name: oyyo-models
repositories.summary: The public catalog of OYYO model candidates, hardware guidance and capability boundaries.
details: Documents 15 local text model candidates for writing, coding, reasoning, technical work and larger workloads.
Also documents the NotzUp speech pack and an optional connected assistance path.
Model listings are candidates and configuration names, not model weights or universal benchmark certificates.
repositories.license: Public catalog documentation with third party model licenses and provenance preserved.

repositories.name: oyyo-sdk
repositories.summary: Python and TypeScript foundations for integrating with the proprietary OYYO orchestration runtime.
details: Provides OpenAI compatible model, chat, response and embedding surfaces.
Documents OYYO native interfaces for memory, media, tools, artifacts, growth, language and hardware.
The public foundation version is 0.1.0 and includes schemas and integration examples.
repositories.license: Public interfaces and examples. The OYYO core runtime remains proprietary.

repositories.name: oyyo-benchmark
repositories.summary: A public evaluation framework for portable, private and business ready AI systems.
details: Measures reasoning, business execution, coding, tools, MCP, artifacts, language, memory, multimodal work, security and hardware efficiency.
Keeps task success, quality, repeatability, latency, memory, throughput and hardware measurements visible.
Defines a reproducibility contract covering model identity, checksum, quantization, runtime, command, configuration, hardware and timestamp.
repositories.license: Public benchmark runner, schemas and methodology. Private OYYO components remain proprietary.

repositories.name: oyyo-agents
repositories.summary: A public directory of 536 specialist role definitions across 24 departments.
details: Roles cover coordination, everyday work, leadership, marketing, sales, support, recruiting, finance, legal, product, software, security, operations, creative work and knowledge.
The catalog supports four levels of specialist responsibility.
A role is a bounded work definition, not a permanently running worker or a new permission.
repositories.license: Public role catalog documentation.

repositories.name: oyyo-teams
repositories.summary: Reusable collaboration patterns for OYYO specialist work.
details: Documents seven built in workflow groups for everyday work, marketing, finance, HR, engineering, research and operations.
Adds 50 specialist team presets built from the wider 536 role catalog.
Explains planning, specialist contributions, review, assembly, reusable profiles and handoffs.
repositories.license: Public team catalog documentation.

repositories.name: oyyo-task-library
repositories.summary: A searchable public catalog of guided tasks, specialist briefs and creative directions.
details: Documents 1,361 guided tasks, including 25 goal templates and 1,336 specialist tasks.
Includes 204 creative styles and expected outputs for common business, research, technical and media work.
Publishes task names and deliverable structures without exposing private prompts, credentials or user templates.
repositories.license: Public task and creative style documentation.

repositories.name: oyyo-catalogs
repositories.summary: Versioned catalog content for roles, teams, tasks and creative styles.
details: Catalog version 2026.11.03.3 covers 536 roles, 50 specialist team presets, 1,361 tasks and 204 styles.
A manifest records the content file, byte count and SHA 256 integrity value.
Compatible workspaces can sync manually and keep the last validated local cache if a later sync fails.
repositories.license: Public content snapshots. No executable plugins or private runtime source are included.

repositories.name: url-metadata-social-fetcher
repositories.summary: Production oriented TypeScript URL enrichment for websites, profiles, products, apps and marketplaces.
details: Extracts titles, descriptions, Open Graph and SEO metadata, canonicals, images, favicons, public social links and brand color hints.
Uses bounded redirect aware and SSRF hardened fetching with zero runtime dependencies on Node 18 or later.
The same pattern is used in live HRN products including BeHot.Now and HORNO Space.
repositories.license: MIT

repositories.name: domoticz
repositories.summary: A multi platform home automation system for monitoring and controlling connected devices.
details: Supports lights, switches, weather and utility sensors, smart meters and many home automation hardware families.
Runs on Linux, Windows and embedded devices with a responsive HTML5 interface.
The public repository belongs to the broader engineering archive. Its upstream project documentation remains authoritative.
repositories.license: Check the repository and upstream project for current licensing and contribution terms.

repositories.name: SmartThingsPublic
repositories.summary: A public archive of SmartThings SmartApps and device type handlers.
details: Provides a large historical collection of SmartThings automation examples and integrations.
Links to SmartThings development documentation, IDE tooling and community resources.
The repository is retained as part of the connected systems engineering archive.
repositories.license: Check the repository history and individual files for applicable terms.

repositories.name: android-ip-camera.device
repositories.summary: A SmartThings custom device integration for an Android IP Camera application.
details: Supports taking photos, recording video, LED control, focus, overlays and night vision when the camera application supports them.
Can expose phone sensor data such as battery, humidity, temperature and ambient light.
The documentation covers device type creation, network setup and SmartThings configuration.
repositories.license: Check the repository for current licensing and platform compatibility.

repositories.name: SmartThings
repositories.summary: A compact public SmartThings automation repository retained in the connected systems archive.
details: Contains historical SmartThings integration work on the master branch.
Use the repository tree and commit history as the authoritative record because no current root README is published.
Platform APIs and compatibility may have changed since the original work.
repositories.license: Check individual files and repository history for applicable terms.

repositories.name: googlecast-wrappers
repositories.summary: JavaScript wrappers for Google Cast sender applications and custom receiver applications.
details: Includes sender and receiver wrappers, examples and an Object.assign compatibility polyfill.
Documents media loading, sessions, custom namespaces and receiver setup.
The code targets an older Google Cast SDK generation and should be evaluated against current platform APIs before use.
repositories.license: Apache 2.0

repositories.name: OpenSource AMLogic Tools
repositories.summary: A public archive of open tooling and workflows for AMLogic based devices.
details: Retained as part of the low level device and embedded systems engineering archive.
The repository tree is the primary source because a current root README is not published.
Review scripts, binaries and device compatibility carefully before using the tools.
repositories.license: Check individual files and repository history for applicable terms.

repositories.name: oyyo-runtime-runner
repositories.summary: A public OYYO runtime distribution component.
details: The public repository currently provides a minimal runtime runner surface.
Its short README identifies OYYO and HRN Innovation Technologies ownership.
Use releases and repository history for the current public artifact state.
